I'm a computational imaging scientist working at the intersection of microscopy, spatial transcriptomics, and machine learning. My background is in neuroscience imaging (in vivo two-photon, ex vivo light-sheet), and I'm building toward roles in imaging ML / computational biology / computational pathology at biotech and AI-for-bio companies.

Recent focus areas:

- Multimodal image registration across imaging modalities and scales
- ML-based quality control for 3D segmentation/ROI data (LightGBM, human-in-the-loop retraining, MLflow)
- Agentic-AI-assisted pipeline development (Claude Code)
- Closing gaps toward computational pathology: whole-slide image tooling, foundation-model embeddings, MIL
